question: Can the HORM E-F-H LEFTNet surface supply a calculator-native, stationary index-one saddle before any GAD/Sella comparison?
hypothesis: At least one T1x endpoint pair will relax and yield a converged climbing-NEB maximum with fmax <= 0.02 eV/A and one projected negative mode on the HORM surface.
design: One full-A100 smoke: relax endpoints on HORM LEFTNet E-F-H, use climbing IDPP-NEB, then check exact autograd Hessian stationarity and projected index. No optimizer is used to construct the candidate.
decision_rule: Proceed to full-Hessian IRC validation only if an independent calculator-native candidate is produced. Otherwise inspect endpoint/NEB failures before allocating more GPU time.

resources.allocation: one A100 3g.20gb MIG slice, 4 CPU cores, 20G memory, 60 minutes

result: One HORM E-F-H candidate was constructed from 15 examined endpoint pairs (sample 14); it passed NEB, fmax <= 0.02 eV/A, and projected n_neg=1 construction gates.
next_action: Validate candidate_000_sample_0014.npz by full-Hessian IRC_TOPO job 65793787 before benchmarking optimizers.
